reason: The earlier entry judged the level "impossible". With the combined workbook (11 independent sources) the reason is now identified, not mysterious: these sites publish the HOUSEHOLD/KABADI pickup tier at 40-52% of metal content, while factory boards quote 82-100%. Steel-Baba names household pickup at Rs 550-700/kg for bartan, so Rs 420 is the very bottom of that tier. The data is real; it is simply the wrong market for a bulk buyer.
action: CORRECTION LOGGED, verdict unchanged: still excluded as Castle price, now for the correct reason (wrong tier, not bad data). Board tier retained at data/manual/brass_board_prices.csv.
